This is the official video guide on how to use Mirror view on Galaxy Z Flip8. Ever needed a mirror when there wasn’t one around? 🪞👀 Turn your phone into a pocket-sized digital mirror for quick checks anywhere with Mirror view. Exclusive to Galaxy Z Flip8, Mirror view lets you zoom in for a closer look, freeze the view to inspect details, and use Ring light for extra brightness. You can even set down your Flip for a hands-free check 😎✨ Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFlip8_Mirrorview_Howto_yt

Follow these steps to set up and use Mirror view on your Galaxy Z Flip8:

Step 1: Open the Camera app, tap 'Quick controls', and select 'Settings'. Swipe up, tap 'Camera Assistant' to download it, and switch on 'Mirror view'. Tap 'Mirror view' to customize your launch options, including 'Quick launch Mirror' via the side button and 'Launch from Lock screen' on the FlexWindow.

This is the official video guide on how to use Gemini Notebook. Got notes, photos, URLs, and ideas scattered everywhere? 😵‍💫 Gemini Notebook helps you pull everything together, make sense of your information and turn it into useful outputs. From planning a trip to staying informed on the go, Infographics and Audio Overviews make your information easier to understand and use. It’s recommended for anyone looking for a smarter way to explore information and organize ideas 🚀 Learn more: http://smsng.co/ZFold8_GeminiNotebook_Howto_yt
